meaning: A short friendly way to say hello.
example: Hi, how was your day?

meaning: An informal word to get attention or greet someone.
example: Hey, wait for me!

meaning: A short word you say when leaving.
example: Bye, see you tomorrow!

meaning: Used to agree or say that something is acceptable.
example: Okay, I will call you at six.
exampleTamil: சரி, நான் ஆறு மணிக்கு உன்னை அழைக்கிறேன்.

meaning: The cold season of the year, after autumn.
example: It gets very cold in the north during winter.

meaning: Used to agree, or to say that things are acceptable.
example: Alright, let us start the class.

meaning: Used to ask if something is true or to add strength.
example: Really? You won the prize?

meaning: An informal way of saying yes.
example: Yeah, I know that song.

meaning: An informal way of saying no.
example: Nope, I have not seen your keys.

meaning: A casual way of saying yes.
example: Yep, I am ready to go.

meaning: Used to show you are very surprised or impressed.
example: Wow, this cake is delicious!
exampleTamil: வாவ், இந்த கேக் மிகவும் சுவையாக இருக்கிறது!

meaning: Said when you make a small mistake.
example: Oops, I dropped my pen.

meaning: Said when you feel sudden pain.
example: Ouch, that hot tea burnt my tongue!
exampleTamil: ஆ, அந்த சூடான தேநீர் என் நாக்கைச் சுட்டுவிட்டது!

meaning: Very good; used to show you are happy about something.
example: That is great news, congratulations!

meaning: Very good or impressive; a casual word of praise.
example: The movie was awesome.

meaning: Very good; used for strong praise.
example: Your idea sounds super.

meaning: The time of day between afternoon and night.
example: We go for a walk every evening.

meaning: The time of day from noon until evening.
example: I take a short nap in the afternoon.

meaning: Twelve o'clock at night.
example: The train reached the station at midnight.

meaning: Twelve o'clock in the day.
example: Let us meet at noon for lunch.

meaning: The first light of the day, just before sunrise.
example: Farmers wake up at dawn.

meaning: Very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain.
example: A big storm hit the town last night.
exampleTamil: நேற்றிரவு ஒரு பெரிய புயல் ஊரைத் தாக்கியது.

meaning: Soft white ice that falls from the sky in very cold places.
example: The children were excited to see snow for the first time.
exampleTamil: குழந்தைகள் முதல் முறையாக பனியைப் பார்த்து உற்சாகமடைந்தனர்.

meaning: At a time before now or before another time.
example: I told you earlier that I was busy.
exampleTamil: நான் பிஸியாக இருக்கிறேன் என்று உன்னிடம் முன்பே சொன்னேன்.

meaning: For all time; without ever ending.
example: I will remember this day forever.
exampleTamil: இந்த நாளை நான் என்றென்றும் நினைவில் வைத்திருப்பேன்.
